messages:
rachel: FYI we're going to trial sessionized attribution sampling to reduce invoice noise for high-volume streaming routes at 14:00 UTC. goal: cut billed token volume for preview while keeping ledger accuracy.
tom: what's the sampling unit? per-session, per-request, or per-token?
rachel: per-session. pick a small fraction of sessions and emit full token stream to ledger, emit sampled indicators for previews and a wiretap for reconciliation.
kevin: important: dedupe must still work across sampled and unsampled flows. if a sampled session is retried we should tag retries with original sampling_decision header.
ops-bot: created dashboard card https://console.internal.redwood/d/session_sample 4 panels: sample-rate, wiretap-lag, preview-vs-ledger-delta. alert rule "sample-preview-drift" at 0.8%.
finance: add requirement: invoice-preview must show confidence band and an "estimated" badge for any tenant with >5% sampled traffic. ops needs CSV export flagged.
claire: UX: add an "exclude sampled sessions" toggle on preview so ops can quickly hide estimates during reconciliations.
tom: technical note: sampling must happen after tokenization to avoid chunk-level bias. also preserve x-rw-request-id and session_id in headers.
kevin: ledger transform needs a field sampling_bucket and sampling_factor so reconciler can scale wiretap counts. add to enrichment schema.
rachel: agreed. I'll push a small schema bump and wiretap topic with header print enabled.
ops-bot: canary plan: 1 partition -> 3 tenants -> monitor 2h -> expand to 10% partitions for 24h. rollback if preview drift > 1% or wiretap lag > 60s.
kevin: add a nightly job to diff wiretap scaled counts vs ledger for the last 24h and emit a drift report to #finance. make threshold 0.3% for Pager.
finance: +1. also add a column with "sampling_reason" so we can identify route causes (embed-heavy, long-session).
claire: small UI change request: show the sample_rate and sampling_bucket in the invoice-preview header for transparency.
tom: watch out for multi-region routing: sampling decisions must be deterministic across regions (hash(session_id + salt)). if we change salt we must rotate carefully.
rachel: using stable-salt v1 for now. ops: please record salt rotation in the rollout notes.
ops-bot: job session-sample-canary started (job id: job-11011).
[14:40] rachel: canary deployed on partition 12. ingest ~6rps, wiretap populating.
[15:25] tom: preview drift 0.45% across cohort, wiretap-lag 18s. no alerts.
[15:50] kevin: reconciler sample-diff shows <0.2% median drift. expanding to 3 partitions per plan.
finance: saw one tenant t-501 with preview under by 1.2%  ops please flag for manual review.
ops-bot: tenant t-501 marked for manual review, exclude_sampled=true.
rachel: paused expansion for t-501 investigation. looks like a chunking edge-case in the embed route; will patch tokenization ordering.
[16:10] ops-bot: job job-11011 completed: partial expand paused, canary remains.
claire: follow-up: add a "why_estimate" modal in the preview UI explaining sampling and linking to the drift report. ops loves docs.
kevin: will add sampling fields to enrichment schema PR and unit tests. assign to me.
rachel: thanks all. reopening thread when we resume expansion.
